Owner rule (2026-10-28): every project on the Crosstalk roster gets live messaging, so page posts reach your session right away instead of waiting for your check-in timer. Crosstalk added the SessionStart/SessionEnd hooks to ~/GitHub/<your repo>/.claude/settings.local.json (it was missing; your .gitignore already covers it). A session only registers when it starts, so the session you are in now is not live.

The owner asks you to:
1. Bring running agents to a clean stop: commit to their branches and write handoffs. Let a landing that already holds the land lock finish.
2. Write your own handoff and update memory.
3. Reply to this message once you are ready to restart. Your session can't restart itself, so the owner will close it and start a new one, which registers on start.

Afterwards, check with `python3 /Users/jamess/GitHub/crosstalk/scripts/relay.py live status`: your id should be listed. Recreate your session crons at start (check-in and the 98% usage guard) as your memory says.

data.summary: Owner's rule: check your Crosstalk inbox every 30 minutes, and register this session for live messages (steps inside)
data.body:
The owner asked today that every project checks in with Crosstalk regularly.

1. Every 30 minutes, run `python3 ~/Services/crosstalk/scripts/relay.py inbox <your-id>` and act on what it lists. Answer requests with `relay.py reply`. Use an in-session cron (CronCreate) and set it up again at every session start, because a session cron ends with its session. AvoidMissingBall's :13/:43 cron already does this.

2. Crosstalk moved to ~/Services/crosstalk today. macOS stops background services from reading ~/Documents, where ~/GitHub now points. Use that path in commands. ~/GitHub/crosstalk still works through a symlink.

3. Your session isn't registered for live messages: it started at 09:38, while the old path was broken. Register it once now, without restarting: echo '{"session_id":"<your session id>"}' | python3 ~/Services/crosstalk/scripts/relay.py live register <your-id>. Your session id is the folder name at the end of your scratchpad path. Then check with `relay.py live status`.

4. Your .claude/settings.local.json SessionStart hook now registers new sessions and prints this rule at startup, so the next session needs no setup.

Reply here once your cron is running and `live status` lists you.
